entries.odia: ଗାଁଆଁବାଲା ପଣସ ଖାଇଲେ, ଭଣ୍ଡାରୀ ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ଅଠା ବୋଳିଲେ
entries.title: Someone else wears the blame
entries.literal_meaning: The villagers ate the jackfruit; they smeared its sticky substance on Bhandari’s head.
entries.explanation: The eaters and the person marked by the sticky residue are different. The headword explicitly explains laying blame or stigma on someone. Our reading follows that transfer: the visible mark is made to point away from those who acted. It is a way to question an accusation, not evidence about any community’s conduct.
entries.meaning_odia: ପଣସ ଖାଇଥିବା ଲୋକ ଓ ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ଅଠା ବୋଳାଯାଇଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଅଲଗା। ଶବ୍ଦର ଅର୍ଥରେ କାହା ଉପରେ ଦୋଷ ବା କଳଙ୍କ ଦେବା କଥା ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଦାଗଟି ପ୍ରକୃତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀଙ୍କ ବଦଳରେ ଅନ୍ୟଜଣଙ୍କୁ ଦୋଷୀ ଦେଖାଉଛି। ଏହା ଅଭିଯୋଗକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରିବାର ପାଠ, କୌଣସି ସମୁଦାୟର ଆଚରଣର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading asks who acted and who was made to carry the visible blame.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ପଚାରେ, କାମ କଲା କିଏ ଓ ଦୋଷର ଦାଗ ବୋହିଲା କିଏ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଦଳର ଭୁଲ ହିସାବ ପାଇଁ କେବଳ ଶେଷରେ ଖାତା ଧରିଥିବା ସଦସ୍ୟଙ୍କୁ ଦୋଷ ଦିଆଗଲା। ସେମାନେ ପୁରୁଣା ଲେଖା ମଧ୍ୟ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କଲେ। / A team checks earlier entries before blaming the person currently holding its ledger. This scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Bhandari retains the source’s ଭଣ୍ଡାରୀ; this head supplies no occupational or caste identification. A provisional historical bird-and-jackfruit fragment is only a possible parallel, not an imported witness.

entries.odia: ଯେ ଲାଗିଯାଏ, ସେ ମାଗିଖାଏ ନାହିଁ, ଯେ ମାଗିଖାଏ ସେ ଲାଗିଖାଏ ନାହିଁ
entries.title: A hard division between working and asking
entries.literal_meaning: Whoever works does not eat by asking; whoever eats by asking does not earn food through work.
entries.explanation: The paired clauses draw an absolute line between labour and asking for food. The headword supplies earning a livelihood through work. Our critical response questions the absolute division: the saying does not establish why anyone needs help or whether their work meets their needs. That response is editorial, not a counter-moral supplied by the dictionary.
entries.meaning_odia: ଧାଡ଼ି ଦୁଇଟି ପରିଶ୍ରମ କରି ଖାଇବା ଓ ମାଗି ଖାଇବାକୁ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଅଲଗା କରିଛି। ଶବ୍ଦର ଅର୍ଥରେ ପରିଶ୍ରମ କରି ପେଟ ପୋଷିବା କଥା ଅଛି। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପାଠ ଏହି କଠୋର ବିଭାଜନକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ। କିଏ କାହିଁକି ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ମାଗୁଛି ବା ତାହାର କାମରୁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ମେଣ୍ଟୁଛି କି, ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ତାହା ପ୍ରମାଣ କରେନାହିଁ। ଏହି ପ୍ରତିପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଆମର, ଅଭିଧାନର ଉପଦେଶ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our critical reading refuses to treat asking for help as proof of not working.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପାଠ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ମାଗିବାକୁ କାମ ନ କରିବାର ପ୍ରମାଣ ମାନେନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ ପଚାରିଲେ, କାମ କରୁଥିବା ଲୋକର ମଧ୍ୟ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଦରକାର ହୋଇପାରେ ନାହିଁ କି? / A reader questions the line’s division rather than judging an actual person seeking help. This discussion is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The categorical claim belongs to the quotation, not verified social observation. No community trait, cause of poverty or guarantee of adequate earnings is established.

entries.odia: ବାଳ ଛାଡ଼ି ଦିଅ ଅଣ୍ଟାରେ ପଡ଼ୁ ଲକ୍ଷେ ଚମ୍ପା ଫୁଲ ଝଡ଼ୁ
entries.title: Let the hair fall
entries.literal_meaning: Let the hair loose, let it fall to the waist; let a hundred thousand champa flowers fall.
entries.explanation: The invitation to loosen the hair opens into an extravagant fall of flowers. The headword’s second sense supports letting hair loose. We read the line as a lyrical image, allowing its abundance to remain playful rather than supplying a practical lesson. The source labels it Dhaga but provides no occasion or explanation of the flower image.
entries.meaning_odia: ବାଳ ଖୋଲିଦେବାର ଆହ୍ୱାନରୁ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଲକ୍ଷେ ଫୁଲ ଝରିବାର ଚିତ୍ରକୁ ଯାଏ। ଶବ୍ଦର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅର୍ଥ ବାଳ ଖୋଲି ଲମ୍ବାଇବାକୁ ବୁଝାଏ। ଆମେ ଏହାକୁ ଏକ ଗୀତିମୟ ଚିତ୍ର ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ୁଛୁ; ଏହାର ପ୍ରଚୁରତାରେ ରସ ଅଛି, ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ବ୍ୟବହାରିକ ଉପଦେଶ ଯୋଡ଼ୁନାହୁଁ। ଉତ୍ସ ଢଗ ବୋଲି ଚିହ୍ନାଇଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅବସର ବା ଫୁଲର ଚିତ୍ରର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଦେଇନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading keeps the lyrical invitation and its abundant flower image without inventing a moral.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଉପଦେଶ ନ ଯୋଡ଼ି ଗୀତିମୟ ଆହ୍ୱାନ ଓ ଫୁଲର ପ୍ରଚୁର ଚିତ୍ରକୁ ରଖେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଜଣେ ପାଠକ ଧାଡ଼ିଟିର ଦୁଇଟି ପଡ଼ୁ ଓ ଝଡ଼ୁ ଶବ୍ଦର ଲୟ ଶୁଣାଇଲେ। / A reader voices the matching endings and discusses the image. This is an invented reading scene, not a documented performance tradition.
entries.cultural_context: No wedding, ritual, speaker’s gender or physical shower of flowers is established. Dictionary-labelled lyrical expression, not a newly documented traditional occasion.

entries.odia: ଟିକିଏ ନିଖିଏ ବଥାକୁ ଏତେ ବଡ଼ କରିବା ନ୍ୟାୟ
entries.title: Making a small thing large
entries.literal_meaning: Provisional rendering: like making a tiny pain or sore so large.
entries.explanation: The comparison moves from something called tiny to something made large. The headword explains the smallness and notes its pairing with ଟିକିଏ. Our editorial application asks whether a description enlarges what happened. It cannot tell us that someone’s actual pain is slight or exaggerated; the source gives no person or medical situation to assess.
entries.meaning_odia: ତୁଚ୍ଛ ବୋଲି କୁହାଯାଇଥିବା କିଛିକୁ ବଡ଼ କରିବାର ତୁଳନା ଏଠାରେ ଅଛି। ଶବ୍ଦର ଅର୍ଥ ଅତି ସାମାନ୍ୟ, ଏବଂ ଟିକିଏ ସହ ଏହାର ବ୍ୟବହାର ବିଷୟରେ ଟୀକା ଅଛି। ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ପଚାରେ, ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନାରେ ଘଟଣାଟି ବଢ଼ାଇ ଦିଆଯାଉଛି କି। କାହାର ପ୍ରକୃତ ବଥା ସାମାନ୍ୟ ବା ଅତିରଞ୍ଜିତ ବୋଲି ଏଥିରୁ କହିହେବନାହିଁ; ବିଚାର ପାଇଁ ଉତ୍ସ କୌଣସି ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ବା ଚିକିତ୍ସା ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ଦେଇନାହିଁ। ବଥା ଶବ୍ଦଟିର ସଠିକ ଅର୍ଥଛାୟା ଏଠାରେ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our application questions an enlarged description, not the credibility of a person in pain.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ବଢ଼ାଇ କହିବାକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ, ବଥା ଭୋଗୁଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କୁ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଗୋଟିଏ ଅକ୍ଷରର ଭୁଲକୁ ପୂରା ଖାତା ନଷ୍ଟ ବୋଲି କୁହାଗଲା। ସମ୍ପାଦକ ପ୍ରକୃତ ଭୁଲଟି ଚିହ୍ନାଇଲେ। / An editor distinguishes one typing error from a claim that an entire notebook is ruined. This application is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The witness is a comparison ending ନ୍ୟାୟ, labelled Dhaga, not a complete incident or diagnosis. Exact ବଥା remains unresolved between pain/sore nuances; no medical judgment is established.
